parameters.name: AllocationId
parameters.description: The ID of the EIP instance to query. You can specify up to 50 EIP instance IDs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the cloud service.

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the cloud service instance to associate. Valid values: 

- **EnsInstance**: a VPC-type ENS instance.

- **SlbInstance**: a load balancing instance.

parameters.name: EipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the EIP to query. You can specify up to 50 EIP addresses separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The array of ENS edge zone IDs. Array length: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: IcmpReplyEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether ICMP echo reply is enabled. Valid values:

- **true** (default): enabled.
- **false**: disabled.

parameters.name: LockReason
parameters.description:
The lock type.
- financial: locked due to overdue payment.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Standby
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the EIP is a standby EIP. Valid values:

- **true**: standby.

- **false**: not standby.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the EIP. Valid values: Associating: being associated. Unassociating: being disassociated. InUse: allocated. Available: available.
